title: When Retries Make Things Worse: Protecting Your System From Overload
content: <html><head></head><body>How a slow dependency becomes an outage, and how deadlines, concurrency limits, retry budgets, and jitter protect useful work. A practical deep dive with PHP examples and a controlled overload test design.</body></html>
author: Wendell Adriel <contact@wendelladriel.com>
